description: Tell Skein about two things Claude Code otherwise never reports on its own. SessionStart (#273): a freshly spawned harness can leave the "spawning" activity phase even before a first prompt writes anything to its transcript. It carries no matcher on purpose, so it fires for every `source` (`startup`, `resume`, `clear`, `compact`, `fork`) rather than only the first — a repeat or phantom fire is harmless because the frontend handler is idempotent, recording a timestamp and only moving the phase when the transcript tail hasn't already spoken for itself, never overriding a permission dialog or an exited harness. PermissionRequest (#86): Claude Code is blocked on a permission dialog, so the room can show "permission required" as its own activity phase instead of folding it into end-of-turn waiting.
